title: Profile consent change request
description: Proposed v0.1 grant/revoke envelope. The owner is derived from the verified bearer principal and is never accepted in the request body.

change_id.description: Stable idempotency key reused with the exact request body on retries.

sharing_scope.description: Household membership and write role must be checked by the service; this field does not grant membership.

preference_type.description: Required for task-scoped reads; omitted for explicit whole-scope device synchronization.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency for this permission/purpose/scope key; zero means no consent record exists.

changed_at.description: Client diagnostic timestamp only; it is not used to resolve conflicts.
